title: Kim Jong-un Reviews North Korea's First Naval Destroyer 'Choe Hyon', Orders June Commission
detail: Kim Jong-un, accompanied by his daughter Kim Ju-ae, reviewed North Korea's first domestically built naval destroyer, the *Choe Hyon*, off the country's west coast on or around May 7, 2026. Kim ordered the vessel handed over to the Korean People's Navy by mid-June 2026, marking a significant milestone in DPRK's naval modernization. The destroyer is seen as part of Kim's 5-year plan to transform the navy into a blue-water capable force with tactical nuclear strike potential. The Choe Hyon features modern armaments including cruise missile systems. Kim Ju-ae's public appearance alongside her father reinforces her continued positioning as a potential political heir.

media.caption: Kim Jong-un reviews North Korea's first naval destroyer and new 155mm artillery systems

title: Kim Inspects Factory Producing 155mm Self-Propelled Howitzers With 60km Range Targeting Seoul
detail: Kim Jong-un visited a munitions factory producing new 155mm self-propelled gun-howitzers with a range exceeding 60 km, sufficient to strike Seoul and surrounding areas from positions near the DMZ. Kim ordered the new artillery systems deployed to southern-border units within 2026. The howitzers represent a significant upgrade in DPRK's conventional strike capacity against South Korea. The 60km range would allow DPRK forces to target central Seoul, Incheon, and US and ROK military installations in the capital region while remaining behind defensive terrain. The South Korean military condemned the deployment announcement.

media.caption: North Korea announces 155mm howitzer deployment with 60km range targeting Seoul
